details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its preinstall hook (`node preinstall.js`) writes a local marker file named DEPENDENCY_CONFUSION_POC_MARKER.txt into the current working directory containing a timestamp and a statement that the package is a security-research placeholder; the package's index.js exports an empty object. The package performs no network requests, collects no data, and reads no environment variables, credentials, or files. No IOCs: it has no network destination.
